title: Sasquatch music festival 2009 - Guy starts dance party
summary: Amateur footage from the 2009 Sasquatch music festival in which one person starts dancing alone and a crowd gradually joins in, turning it into a dance party.
why: Used as the classic example of a lone first follower turning one person's action into a movement, in threads about bystanders and group behavior.

quote.text: I think the most amazing/hilarious example I've seen of one person starting something by making the first move
